# crosswork_golden_config_templates (Data Source)

This data source can read a template of Golden Configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_golden_config_templates" "example" {
  id = "cwtest-ntp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object, the template name

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Boolean) Whether the template is part of the global conformance schedule
- `config` (String) Configuration text with Jinja2 variables
- `config_id` (Number) The integer id of the configuration of the template, which a job refers to
- `config_type` (String) Format of the configuration text
- `description` (String) Description
- `mode` (String) How the configuration is applied
- `name` (String) Template name
- `product_series` (Set of String) Product series of the devices
- `software_type` (String) Software type of the devices
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the template
- `template_id` (Number) The integer id the controller gave the template
- `variables` (Attributes List) Variables of the template, sorted by name; the controller returns the values in clear text (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the devices

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Variable name
- `type` (String) Type of the value
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value
